The declared ladder is the comparison config's budgets executed in descending order; the shipped pipeline used [6, 12, 25, 50, 100].

Recorded similarities are rounded to 4 decimals and every selection (first-strict-max over propose/compress candidates, strict-improvement refinement) compares the recorded values, so the archived selection is replayable from the archive alone without MLX.
The explicit-reconstruction arm is generated under the declared wrapper exactly as the shipped procedure does, and is retained only as the tagged copy baseline.

The shared wall-clock envelope and the digest-bound comparison record are comparison declarations around the readable run; the runner records its own measured operation seconds (model load excluded, as on the raw side) and never tunes after the fact.
